regions.merged_text: Apendix Saved - Doctor Disapointed & Angered. Walter Sullivan 22 - 209 E. Philad. Ave - ( clerk in People's State Bank) very sick of apendicitis, waiting in St. Mary's Hospital for operation to be performed at 7 p.m. All Saints Day, at about 3.30 p.m. same day a request for enrollment came by phone - as a perpetual mem- ber in S.M.A. At 7.17 p.m. phone brought word: "No operation .. Dr. wanted to operate, but we are just leaving Hospital now ... He - the patient - will be up to see you tomorrow." He drove the car home himself while all said litany His Father reciting by heart and the rest answering - litany of B.V.Mary. To-day he comes with his Mother in perfect condition - has been work- ing ever since. Deo Gratias

regions.merged_text: Dorothy Dettloff 13393 Young Ave. only baby after ten years pray- ing to be blest with children, is enrolled the day of her birth when dispaired of and receives transfusion of blood same day. Three days after she received another transfusion and To-day after 7 months is the picture of health. The Doctor (E. Robinson) a non catholic wondered at the recover as a positive miracle de- claring "Indeed there must be a divine power behind such a cure."
